kicker: Auckland Theravada Buddhist Association · Vimutti Buddhist Monastery · Bombay, Auckland, New Zealand
cpiName: the New Zealand consumer price index (World Bank; the average of the two calendar years a year to 31 July spans)
costDefShort: total expenditure as the Association reports it to the register.
defs: Spending: the total expenditure the Association reports to the New Zealand Charities Register each year; the register shows only this total. Residents: the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas listed at Vimutti on the community lists, on average; guests and lay residents are not counted. Inflation: the New Zealand consumer price index (World Bank). All amounts in New Zealand dollars, as paid at the time, unless the page says "in today's money".
meaningNote: The register gives only two totals a year, so this page cannot say what the money was spent on.
notes: Where the figures come from. The annual returns of the Auckland Theravada Buddhist Association Incorporated (charity CC20332) on the New Zealand Charities Register: total income and total expenditure for the years to 31 July (register_returns.txt in this folder keeps the table). The Association runs Vimutti Buddhist Monastery at Bombay, south of Auckland (vimutti.org.nz).
Years. The Association's year runs from 1 August to 31 July and is named by the year it ends in: "2025" is August 2024 to July 2025.

Check the spending in the early years. The figures are shown exactly as the register has them, from 2012 (the register also lists 2008 to 2011, all $0, which are not charted). Several spending figures look too low for a monastery that was running: $0 for 2019, 2021 and 2022, $45,000 for 2020, and $37,584 and $32,011 for 2012 and 2013, in years when it took in $100,000 to $360,000. Treat those years with care: they may be missing from the filing, not real. 2023 to 2025 look complete. The audited reports behind the earlier returns were not read.
Spending is total spending. It can include building work and wear on buildings; the register does not separate them, so this page shows no running cost and no change after inflation.
Residents are the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas on the community lists (the Winter list of January and the Vassa list of July). Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
sources: Sources anyone can check: the New Zealand Charities Register, Auckland Theravada Buddhist Association Incorporated (CC20332). Residents: the monasteries' community lists. Updated __UPDATED__
